selectedExcerpt.before: Player beside an illuminated window/blue wall lights and lift, with keyboard interaction prompt.
selectedExcerpt.action: Player activates the lift, rides upward while the game camera follows, then runs toward the yellow exit.
selectedExcerpt.result: The actual game character remains recognizable in its animated game environment; this anchors the sourced character-production case to the real game.
selectedExcerpt.claimSupportedByVisibleFootage: This is the actual Dead Cells character in motion, in a lit 2D game environment.
selectedExcerpt.claimNotDemonstrated: No normal-map ON/OFF toggle, exported normal buffer, lighting-factor measurement, per-pixel internal normal, geometry count, or isolated causal lighting test is observable from this final gameplay recording. Do not identify healing/roll flashes as normal mapping.

Game starts exit letterboxing/HUD removal and then changes area; use clean endpoint36.6 instead.
